content.text:
I opened PR #393 (https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/393) with both changes to `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`. It hasn't been run yet: the new setup only takes effect when the assistant workflow runs on `main` after merge.

**Changes:**
- The "Run pi-action" step now uses `cv/pi-action@27723deedf4b41e99924171402c657c8d4e9ff69 # v2.5.4`. I checked that this hash is the commit the `v2.5.4` tag points to.
- I removed the `env: NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT: all` block and its comment from that step, so pi-action's own `--allow-git=root` setting applies.

**Can `NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT: all` go?** Yes. pit's dependencies all come from the npm registry, and `package-lock.json` has no packages installed from git. So `root`, which only allows the specs listed in `extensions`, is enough.

**To finish:** The PR description says `Refs #392` rather than `Closes`, so merging won't close the issue. After merging, check that the next assistant run installs `github:cv/pit#…` without the override, then close #392. If that install fails, put `NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT: all` back.
